component.name: PosterItem
component.script:
sub init_x() m.g = m.top.findNode("g") m.border = m.top.findNode("border") m.ph = m.top.findNode("ph") m.poster = m.top.findNode("poster") m.label = m.top.findNode("label") m.barBg = m.top.findNode("barBg") m.bar = m.top.findNode("bar") m.fade = m.top.findNode("fade") m.poster.observeField("loadStatus", "onLoad") accent = "0xE50914FF" if m.global.hasField("accent") and m.global.accent <> invalid and m.global.accent <> "" then accent = m.global.accent m.border.color = accent m.bar.color = accent layout() end sub sub init() try init_x() catch e reportCrash("PosterItem.init", e) end try end sub
sub layout_x() w = m.top.width h = m.top.height if w <= 0 then w = 180 if h <= 0 then h = 270 m.border.translation = [-5, -5] m.border.width = w + 10 m.border.height = h + 10 m.ph.width = w m.ph.height = h m.poster.width = w m.poster.height = h m.label.width = w - 20 m.label.height = h - 20 m.barBg.translation = [4, h - 14] m.barBg.width = w - 8 m.g.scaleRotateCenter = [w / 2, h / 2] m.barWidth = w - 8 end sub sub layout() try layout_x() catch e reportCrash("PosterItem.layout", e) end try end sub
sub onContent_x() c = m.top.itemContent if c = invalid then return m.label.text = c.title if m.poster.uri = c.HDPosterUrl and m.poster.loadStatus = "ready" m.poster.opacity = 1 else m.poster.opacity = 0 m.poster.uri = c.HDPosterUrl end if p = 0.0 if c.hasField("progress") then p = c.progress if p > 0.01 if p > 1 then p = 1 m.barBg.visible = true m.bar.width = Int(m.barWidth * p) else m.barBg.visible = false end if end sub sub onContent() try onContent_x() catch e reportCrash("PosterItem.onContent", e) end try end sub
sub onLoad_x() if m.poster.loadStatus = "ready" m.fade.control = "start" end if end sub sub onLoad() try onLoad_x() catch e reportCrash("PosterItem.onLoad", e) end try end sub
sub onFocus_x() f = m.top.focusPercent if not m.top.rowListHasFocus and not m.top.gridHasFocus then f = 0 s = 1.0 + 0.07 * f m.g.scale = [s, s] m.border.opacity = f end sub sub onFocus() try onFocus_x() catch e reportCrash("PosterItem.onFocus", e) end try end sub
